hub.title: Seller hub
hub.subtitle: List a product, run your stores, follow your auctions.

stores.title: My stores
stores.emptyHint: Add a store to start selling. Every product belongs to one of your stores.
stores.deleteConfirm: It is removed with its listing details. This can't be undone.
stores.defaultHint: New products go to this store unless you choose another.
stores.coverHint: Shown across the top of your store page.

products.lockedInAuction: Locked while it is in an auction. Manage it from My auctions.
products.title: My products
products.emptyHint: Add a product first, then put it up for auction.
products.deleteConfirm: Delete this product? This cannot be undone.
products.blockedNoReason: Bidoom blocked this product, so it can't go up for auction.
products.deleteBody: It is removed from your products. This can't be undone.
products.coverHint: The first photo is the cover buyers see.
products.pendingPhotosHint: The photos upload when you save the product.
products.notFound: This product isn't in your products any more.

auctions.title: My auctions
auctions.emptyHint: Create an auction from one of your products.
auctions.submitHint: An admin reviews your listing before it goes live.
auctions.cancelConfirm: It comes off Bidoom. You can list the product again later.
auctions.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this listing from review? It is cancelled and you can list the product again later.
auctions.notEditable: Only drafts and rejected auctions can be edited.
auctions.lockedWithBids: It has bids, so it can no longer be cancelled.
auctions.saleCancelled: The sale was cancelled; you can list it again.
auctions.notFound: This auction isn't in your auctions any more.

fields.marketPriceHint: We show buyers how much they save against the new price.
fields.buyNowHint: Ends the auction immediately when paid. Optional.
fields.oneLanguageHint: Arabic or English is enough; the other language shows the same text until you add it.
fields.extensionRule: Every bid in the last {{minutes, num}} minutes adds {{minutes, num}} minutes, up to {{times, num}} times, protecting bidders from last-second sniping.
fields.bidStepHint: The least each bid must add. Suggested for a {{opening}} opening: {{step}}.
fields.bidStepHintEmpty: The least each bid must add, from 250 IQD up to the opening price.

toast.auctionDraftSaved: Draft saved. Publish it when you are ready.
toast.auctionPublished: Published. Your auction is on Bidoom.
toast.auctionSentForReview: Sent for review. It goes live once Bidoom approves it.
